title: India's Wetlands Cross 98 Ramsar Sites
summary: Two new sites—Patna Bird Sanctuary (UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Gujarat)—pushed India's Ramsar site count to 98 on 31 January 2026.

blocks.content: On 31 January 2026, two new wetland sites were designated as Ramsar sites ahead of World Wetlands Day (2 Feb), taking India's total count to **98 Ramsar sites** (a 276% growth from 26 in 2014).

items: **New Sites**: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah, UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Kutch, Gujarat).
**Ramsar Convention**: Adopted 1971 in Ramsar, Iran; India ratified in 1982.
**World's First Ramsar Site**: Cobourg Peninsula, Australia (1974).

blocks.title: High-Recall Figure
blocks.content: The exact current count of Ramsar sites in India is 98.
